q: By the time the meeting starts, we ______ prepared the presentation.
I am a teacher. I ___ a teacher for 12 years.
e: 'for 12 years' অতীত থেকে এখন পর্যন্ত চলমান সময় বোঝায়, তাই present perfect tense লাগে। subject I এর সাথে 'have been' হয়। অর্থ: আমি একজন শিক্ষক। আমি বারো বছর ধরে শিক্ষক আছি। 'was' সরল অতীত, কিন্তু প্রথম বাক্য 'I am a teacher' দেখায় এখনও তাই আছি। 'am' এ সময়ের পরিধি নেই। 'am being' এ সাময়িক আচরণ বোঝায়, পেশা নয়।

q: Identify the correct sentence.
o: He waited until she had finished speaking.
He waited until she have been finished speaking.
He waited until she finishes speaking.
He waited until she had been finishing speaking.

q: It has not been long since I ____ her.
e: Since দিয়ে অতীতের কোনো নির্দিষ্ট ঘটনার সময়বিন্দু বোঝালে মূল অংশে present perfect থাকে এবং since-এর পরের অংশে সাধারণত past indefinite বসে। এখানে মূল অংশ It has not been long, তাই পরের অংশে past indefinite saw বসে। উদাহরণ: It has been two years since he left। মনে রাখুন: see হলো present, had seen হলো past perfect এবং have seen হলো present perfect; এই কাঠামোয় এগুলোর কোনোটিই খাটে না।

q: Past perfect continuous form of 'I eat' is-
e: Past perfect continuous-এর কাঠামো had been + V-ing, তাই I had been eating। অর্থ: আমি খেয়ে চলছিলাম (কোনো অতীত সময় পর্যন্ত)। I have eaten Present Perfect, I am eating Present Continuous, আর I shall be eating Future Continuous। had been দেখলেই Past Perfect Continuous বুঝতে হবে।

q: It has been five years since we _____ Italy.
Identify the correct sentence.
o: They will have discussed the plan after they reviewed all the documents.
They will discuss the plan after they reviews all the documents.
They will discuss the plan after they had reviewed all the documents.
They will discuss the plan after they have reviewed all the documents.

q: Which one is the Future Continuous Tense?
o: They will have visited their grandparents.
They will be visiting their grandparents.

q: At four he (look) the same as now.
e: 'At four' এখানে চার বছর বয়সের কথা বোঝাচ্ছে, যা অতীত কাল, তাই verb এর অতীত রূপ লাগে। look এর অতীত রূপ 'looked'। অর্থ: চার বছর বয়সে সে এখনকার মতোই দেখতে ছিল। 'looks' বর্তমান কাল, যা অতীত বয়সের সাথে মেলে না। 'look' plural form বা base form। 'looking' finite verb নয়। 'the same as now' শুধু তুলনা করছে, কালের নির্দেশ দিচ্ছে না।

q: "He had eaten." Which form of tense does the sentence represent?
Fill in the blank: By the time she comes, we _________.
Fill in the gap with the right tense: Many years have passed since you ____ that place.
Identify the correct sentence.
o: Six weeks had gone by since I had started my new Job.
Six weeks have gone by since I started my new Job.
Six weeks has gone by since I started my new Job.
Six weeks have gone by since I have started my new Job.

q: Scarcely had the meeting begun when the electricity ______.
I ___ a letter before he arrived.
e: before-এর পরে arrived আছে, তাই আগের কাজটি past perfect হবে: had written। অর্থ: সে আসার আগেই আমি একটি চিঠি লিখে ফেলেছিলাম। wrote দিলে কাজ দুটির আগে-পরে স্পষ্ট হয় না। have written present perfect, অতীতের কাজের সাথে মেলে না। was writing চলমান কাজ বোঝায়, লেখা শেষ হওয়া বোঝায় না।

____ she ever driven a car?

o: I will finish my homework tomorrow.
I will have finished my homework by 7 PM.
I am finishing my homework now.
